name: MS-PE-kubernetes-cronjob
desc: Kubernetes CronJob persistence (MS-PE-kubernetes-cronjob) — a Pod owned by CronJob->Job is flagged; controller-stop+kinds (== native ActionRotate) is DELIBERATELY NOT eligible because the Job owner is Stateful (statefulIntegrity refuses a destructive rotate), so the brain contains it via quarantine instead — NOT-DEFENDED by controller-stop+kinds (safety boundary, by design)

fixture.requirement: NONE — by design. The ControllerStopKindsFamily adapter's preflight() short-circuits any owner_kind in {Job, CronJob} to an honest NOT-DEFENDED BEFORE standing up any fixture: controller-stop+kinds (rotate) is deliberately infeasible on a stateful Job-owned pod, so there is nothing to provision or fire. `do NOT force it`.

The contrast proof is the DaemonSet reps T1053.007 + T1543.005: IDENTICAL coverage, same trusted event, but DaemonSet owner -> DEFENDED. quarantine is the correct system defense here (contain the malicious CronJob pod while preserving state).
